entities.summary: Gregory Newsome II is an American professional football cornerback for the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Northwestern Wildcats and was selected by the Cleveland Browns in the first round of the 2021 NFL draft. He has also played in the NFL for the Jacksonville Jaguars.
